sentences.en: A neighbour asked to buy half of it from him.
Juha thought and then said: good.
They divided the donkey in words.
The neighbour said: the front half is mine.
Juha said: and the back half is mine.
The donkey stayed in Juha’s yard.
After a few days there was a load.

sentences.ar: ג'וחא רצה לשים אותו על החמור.
sentences.en: Juha wanted to put it on the donkey.

sentences.ar: השכן אמר: לא על החלק שלי.
sentences.en: The neighbour said: not on my part.

sentences.ar: ג'וחא שם הכול על החלק שלו.
sentences.en: Juha put everything on his part.

sentences.ar: אחר כך הוא הפסיק לתת אוכל.

sentences.en: The neighbour asked: why is it hungry?

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר: הפה שלך, לא שלי.
sentences.en: Juha said: the mouth is yours, not mine.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אני מאכיל את הזנב.
sentences.en: He said: I feed the tail.
The neighbour asked to cancel the purchase.
